claims.text: Supportive care for rhinosinusitis: oral decongestants such as pseudoephedrine
claims.quote: supportive care, which includes nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs for pain, nasal saline sprays, mucolytics such as guaifenesin, intranasal glucocorticoids, oral decongestants such as pseudoephedrine, and topical nasal vasoconstrictors (phenylephrine or oxymetazoline)

claims.text: Pseudoephedrine HCl 30 mg tablet (OTC nasal decongestant); temporarily relieves sinus congestion and pressure
claims.quote: Pseudoephedrine HCl 30 mg Purpose Nasal decongestant Uses temporarily relieves sinus congestion and pressure

claims.text: Adults and children 12 years and over: 2 tablets every 4 to 6 hours; no more than 8 tablets in 24 hours
claims.quote: adults and children 12 years and over take 2 tablets every 4 to 6 hours do not take more than 8 tablets in 24 hours

claims.text: Do not use in children under 6 years
claims.quote: do not use this product in children under 6 years of age

claims.text: Do not use with an MAOI, or for 2 weeks after stopping one
claims.quote: Do not use if you are now taking a prescription monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) (certain drugs for depression, psychiatric or emotional conditions, or Parkinson's disease), or for 2 weeks after stopping the MAOI drug.

claims.text: Ask a doctor first with heart disease, high blood pressure, thyroid disease, diabetes, or trouble urinating due to an enlarged prostate
claims.quote: Ask a doctor before use if you have heart disease high blood pressure thyroid disease diabetes trouble urinating due to an enlarged prostate gland
claims.locator: Warnings › Ask a doctor before use

claims.text: Stop and ask a doctor if nervousness, dizziness or sleeplessness occur, or if symptoms do not improve within 7 days or occur with a fever
claims.quote: Stop use and ask a doctor if nervousness, dizziness, or sleeplessness occur symptoms do not improve within 7 days or occur with a fever
